title: Layer 4: Quality gates at /work-finish
description:
Highest immediate value. Configurable pre-finish checklist that verifies:
- Tests pass (configurable command per project)
- Lint clean (configurable)
- PR approved (if GitHub tracker)
- Docs updated (if doc impact detected)
- Beads issues closed (if beads tracker)

Gate results are logged (mirrors Notion Gate Log database). Configurable per profile in overrides.yaml. Add /work-review command or integrate as pre-finish gate.

title: Abstract AskUserQuestion into generic prompt interface
description:
Claude Code uses AskUserQuestion tool for interactive prompts. OpenCode has the question() tool. Create a generic prompt interface that:
- Detects which tool is available
- Provides a consistent API for yes/no confirmations, text input, and multi-choice
- Falls back gracefully if neither is available (use defaults)

This is used extensively in start.md (5 prompts) and finish.md (4+ prompts). Should also reduce prompt count — implement sensible defaults with opt-out.

title: Create OpenCode adapter layer
description:
Generate OpenCode-compatible skill files (.opencode/skills/workflow/) from the shared core. OpenCode uses markdown SKILL.md files with YAML frontmatter and mcp.json for tool registration. Follow the pattern established in phil-ai for MCP-backed skills.

Key decisions:
- Will the workflow scripts be accessed via MCP server or direct bash execution?
- Should this use the phil-ai generator pattern or be simpler (direct markdown)?
- How to handle AskUserQuestion equivalent in OpenCode?

title: Phase 1: Cross-tool portability — OpenCode + Claude Code adapters
description:
Create adapter layers so the workflow plugin works in both OpenCode and Claude Code.

Architecture: Shared core (skills/workflow/) + thin adapters.
- Claude Code adapter: existing .claude-plugin/ manifest + commands/
- OpenCode adapter: .opencode/skills/ with SKILL.md files that reference shared core
- Generic prompt interface abstracting AskUserQuestion
- Installation docs for each tool

Blocked by Phase 0 (foundation cleanup must happen first).
Cross-ref: pjb-ua0 in workspace beads.

title: Add beads (bd) as first-class issue_tracker option
description: The plugin predates beads. Now that beads is the primary task tracker, add bd as a first-class option alongside GitHub in overrides.yaml. /work-start should support bd create, /work-finish should bd close, /work-status should incorporate bd ready. Map the existing issue_tracker abstraction to support beads.

title: Remove .workflow/core/ fallback and fix finish.md doc-impact path bug
description:
Two cleanup items:
1. SKILL.md references .workflow/core/ with specs like branch-strategy.md as alternative to plugin's reference/ directory. Creates two sources of truth. Remove fallback, use reference/ only.
2. finish.md references $HOME/.claude/skills/workflow/scripts/detect-doc-impact.sh — hardcoded path that doesn't use $CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT (bug). Fix to use $WORKFLOW_ROOT.

title: Replace hardcoded /Users/pjbeyer/Projects/ paths
description: Hardcoded absolute paths in SKILL.md, status.md, resume.md, finish.md, and scripts. Replace with $HOME/Projects/ or a configurable base path from overrides.yaml.

title: Replace $CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT with $WORKFLOW_ROOT abstraction
description: ~30 occurrences of $CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT across SKILL.md, start.md, finish.md, status.md, resume.md, and scripts. Replace with $WORKFLOW_ROOT that can be set by either Claude Code or OpenCode adapter layer. This is the #1 blocker for portability.

title: Phase 0: Foundation cleanup — prepare for new features and portability
description:
Remove dead integrations, abstract tool-specific coupling, fix hardcoded paths. This cleans up ~200 lines and unblocks both portability (Phase 1) and new features (Phase 2).

Subtasks:
- Replace all $CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT with $WORKFLOW_ROOT (set by adapter layer)
- Replace all hardcoded /Users/pjbeyer/Projects/ with $HOME/Projects/ or config
- Remove OmniFocus integration entirely (~50 lines across start.md/finish.md)
- Remove Jira manual integration (~40 lines across start.md/finish.md/resume.md)
- Remove Superpowers plugin detection (~60 lines in SKILL.md/finish.md/start.md)
- Remove .workflow/core/ fallback (~20 lines in SKILL.md)
- Fix hardcoded path bug in finish.md doc impact detection
- Add beads (bd) as first-class issue_tracker option in overrides.yaml

Net: ~150 lines smaller after cleanup.
Cross-ref: pjb-ua0 in workspace beads.

title: Phase 2: New workflow layers — Control, Intake, Improvement, Context, Execution
description:
Implement the 5-layer Personal AI Workflow framework features beyond the existing Execution layer.

Implementation order (by value):
1. Control (Layer 4) — Quality gates at /work-finish, configurable checklists
2. Intake (Layer 1) — Quick capture during coding sessions, /capture command
3. Improvement (Layer 5) — Outcome logging, /work-retro command, scorecard
4. Context (Layer 2) — Context retrieval, PARA-aware, context manifests
5. Execution (Layer 3) — Templates, model routing, extensible operations

Cross-ref: pjb-ua0 in workspace beads. Framework design from pjb-ltm.

title: Layer 5: Feedback loop — outcome logging and /work-retro
description:
Compounding gains from observed outcomes. Extend existing metrics capture.

1. Outcome logging: extend JSON Lines events at /work-finish time with wins/misses/surprises
2. /work-retro command for periodic review:
   - Summarize work completed in period
   - Highlight stale work (>7 days, already in status.md)
   - Surface patterns from outcome logs
   - Suggest workflow improvements
3. Scorecard integration: monthly self-assessment aligned with 11-dimension Scorecard Template from Notion
4. Waste detection: duplicate work, abandoned branches, unused templates

title: Layer 1: Quick capture during coding sessions
description:
No lost inputs. New /capture or /work-capture command for fast idea/bug/todo logging.

Configurable capture targets per profile:
- beads: bd q 'captured item' (primary)
- GitHub issue: gh issue create
- Notion: via MCP skill
- Local: ~/Projects/.workflow/inbox/{profile}.jsonl (fallback)

Auto-detect context: current repo, branch, file. Minimal friction — one-line capture.
Optional: triage skill that periodically processes inbox into proper issues.

title: Remove Jira manual integration
description: Jira path is purely manual: 'Create Jira task manually, then paste the key.' Zero automation. ~40 lines of conditional logic across start.md, finish.md, resume.md. If work profile needs issue tracking, GitHub or beads provides it with actual automation.

title: Remove Superpowers plugin detection
description: has_superpowers() checks ~/.claude/plugins/cache/superpowers — tight coupling to a specific Claude Code plugin. suggest_superpowers_skill() in SKILL.md and Step 3.5/Step 8 code in finish.md/start.md add ~60 lines. If superpowers patterns are valuable, internalize them as proper workflow skills.

title: Remove OmniFocus integration
description: AppleScript-based, macOS-only, ~50 lines across start.md and finish.md. Beads (bd) is now the task tracking system. Remove entirely — OmniFocus adds complexity (AppleScript error handling, optional feature flags, completion matching) for a workflow superseded by beads.

title: Layer 3: Execution extensions — templates, model routing, new operations
description:
Extend existing execution layer:
- Reusable workflow templates beyond doc-issue.md (PR templates, review checklists, standup summaries)
- Model routing guidance in skill docs: lightweight tasks (summaries, triage) vs heavyweight (architecture, debugging)
- Standardized output formats for each command
- Template for adding new workflow operations (make plugin extensible)
- Reduce over-prompted UX: sensible defaults with opt-out instead of 5+ interactive prompts

title: Layer 2: Context retrieval — PARA-aware structured context loading
description:
Right context available at execution time. Profile detection exists but no context retrieval.

Build:
- Context loading skill that surfaces relevant info for current work:
  - Recent commits and PR history
  - Related issues/tasks from beads or GitHub
  - Prior decisions from .workflow/ or .sisyphus/
  - Profile-specific conventions
- PARA-aware: Projects (active), Areas (ongoing), Resources (reference), Archive (inactive)
- Context manifests per profile/project declaring what to load for AI agents
- Extend overrides.yaml with context configuration
